# APA (7th edition) references and in-text citations for the made-up publications in test_citations.cpp.
# Italics are between asterisks.

[article]
ref: Example, A. B., & Sample, B. (2021). Lattice Vibrations in Pretend Crystals. *Journal of Imaginary Findings*, *3*(2), 43–70. https://doi.org/10.5555/jif.2021.0002
cite: (Example & Sample, 2021)

[article-print]
ref: Dent, C. (2019). Why Do Models Fail? *Made-Up Review*, *12*, 101–108.
cite: (Dent, 2019)

[article-seven-authors]
ref: Alpha, A., Beta, B., Gamma, C., Delta, D., Epsilon, E., Zeta, F., & Eta, G. (2022). Collaborative Pretend Measurements. *Journal of Imaginary Findings*, *4*(1), 1496–1500. https://example.org/paper
cite: (Alpha et al., 2022)

[article-no-author]
ref: Editorial. (2020). *Pretend Letters*, *1*(1), 1.
cite: (“Editorial,” 2020)

[book]
ref: Fiction, D. (2018). *Imaginary Structures: A Practical Guide* (3rd ed.). Example Press.
cite: (Fiction, 2018)

[edited-book]
ref: Editor, E., & Compiler, F. (Eds.). (2015). *Collected Pretend Essays*. Example Press.
cite: (Editor & Compiler, 2015)

[chapter]
ref: Writer, G. (2015). A Chapter on Nothing. In E. Editor (Ed.), *Collected Pretend Essays* (pp. 37–49). Example Press.
cite: (Writer, 2015)

[paper]
ref: Tanaka, H., Garcia, I., & Park, J. (2016). Fast Pretend Sorting. In *Proceedings of the Made-Up Conference on Examples* (pp. 195–203). Example Society. https://doi.org/10.5555/mce.2016.17
cite: (Tanaka et al., 2016)

[proceedings]
ref: Lee, K. (Ed.). (2016). *Proceedings of the Made-Up Conference on Examples*. Example Society.
cite: (Lee, 2016)

[issue]
ref: *Journal of Imaginary Findings*. (2021). *3*(2). Example Press.
cite: (*Journal of Imaginary Findings*, 2021)

# Cases are cited in a legal form in every style: the Bluebook's unless OSCOLA's is chosen.
[case_us]
ref: *Sample v. Example County Board*, 12 F.4th 345 (9th Cir. 2021)
cite: (*Sample v. Example County Board*, 2021)

[case_uk]
